subject: Prorated charge & tax-exempt coordination for mid-cycle seat increase
messages:

Cc: Purchasing <procurement@pinecresthealth.com>

Subject: Seat increase on Oct 20 — invoice/proration and tax exempt status

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

We added 12 additional inference seats to our Redwood Dedicated pool on Oct 20 as part of our rollout. Our billing cycle runs from the 1st of the month. Can you confirm how Redwood will charge for the partial month (Oct 20–31) and whether a corrected invoice / credit will be issued?

Also — Pinecrest is tax-exempt in CA. Please let me know what documentation you need from us (sales tax exemption certificate, PO) and how that will show up on the corrected invoice.

PO info: PO-PT-9981 (will confirm signer).

Thanks,
Alex

Subject: Re: Seat increase on Oct 20 — invoice/proration and tax exempt status

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and the PO number.

Quick answers up front:
- We will prorate the 12-seat uplift from Oct 20–31 on your current Oct invoice and can either include the charge on Oct or post a corrected invoice with separate line items and a credit for the previous estimate.
- For tax-exempt handling we need a signed CA resale/exemption certificate (PDF). If you send that, we will reissue the invoice without CA sales tax.

Marissa — can you run a provisional proration and attach the draft invoice? I dropped the initial calculator in the shared spreadsheet for transparency. Ben / Michael — FYI in case we need to route to Collections or apply a credit balance.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@pinecresthealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Seat increase on Oct 20 — invoice/proration and tax exempt status

Alex / team — attaching a provisional calculation and a corrected-invoice draft for visibility. Summary below:

Background: base seats = 24 (billed monthly). Uplift = +12 seats on Oct 20. Billing month = Oct (31 days).
Pricing: $150 / seat / month (standard committed seat rate).
Proration window: Oct 20–31 inclusive = 12 days. Proration fraction = 12 / 31 = 0.3871
Prorated charge: 12 seats * $150 * 0.3871 = $697.00 (rounded to nearest dollar)

We can:
1) Issue a corrected invoice dated Oct 20 that includes the prorated line and remove the provisional estimate charge (if you were billed an interim estimate).
2) Apply the prorated charge on the Oct invoice and show a line item for the tax-exempt adjustment once we receive your CA certificate.

If Pinecrest provides the tax-exempt certificate, the corrected invoice will show: net charge $697.00, sales tax $0.00, total $697.00. If not received, CA sales tax (estimated 8.25%) would be applied and we would adjust on reissue once we receive evidence.

Next steps requested from Pinecrest:
- Send CA sales tax exemption PDF (signed) to billing@redwood.ai
- Confirm PO number / final approver for invoice.

I attached: provisional-proration-estimate.xlsx (calculator) and corrected-invoice-draft.pdf (draft format). The dollar figures above are drafts pending your certificate.

Marissa Cole
Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: provisional-proration-estimate.xlsx, corrected-invoice-draft.pdf

- Please show the corrected invoice as "Corrected Invoice — Prorated Seats Oct 20" and include PO-PT-9981 on the header.
- Who will sign the amended contract (if any)? We can either accept the corrected invoice + PO or execute a small amendment. If DocuSign is easier for you, send the link.
- If you can confirm the timeline for the corrected invoice and whether the $697 will be charged immediately or deferred to the Nov invoice, that helps our cash planning.

Best,
Alex

Alex / Pinecrest team — all set on our side. Confirmation and next steps below: 

1) We received the CA exemption PDF and validated it against our tax rules. No CA sales tax will be charged for the corrected invoice.
2) We'll issue a corrected invoice titled "Corrected Invoice — Prorated Seats Oct 20" with PO-PT-9981 on the header. Line items will show the 12-seat prorated charge ($697.00) and sales tax $0.00.
3) Timing: corrected invoice will be posted to your account and emailed by EOD Monday, Oct 26. The charge will be invoiced immediately (not deferred). If you prefer to net it against November, let us know and we can instead issue a credit and include the net on Nov invoice.
4) Contract amendment: not required for this seat uplift; the corrected invoice + PO is sufficient. If your procurement team prefers a signed amendment we can send a short DocuSign amendment (link below) — otherwise we'll proceed on invoice + PO.

DocuSign link (optional): https://redwoodapp.app/docusign/amendment/ABC123
HubSpot reference: HS-098273

Ben / Michael — please apply the corrected invoice when issued and route any collection questions to Collections if payment terms change.

Thanks — Hannah
